messages:
Maya: Preflight for tonight's segmented blue->green swap. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: 4-step phased weights (10/30/60/100) every 5m. Green currently pinned v2.14.3, blue is v2.16.0 candidate. Please ack and standby for traffic commands.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: service=router, target=blue, image=redwood/router:v2.16.0, deploy_id=dep-2027-04-12-1798123456. LB policy=weighted; healthchecks=baseline; roll_interval=5m.

Jordan: Ack. I'll own realtime monitoring (errors + latency). I'll watch p50/p95, error-rate, and router CPU.

Kevin: I'll kick off cache warmup and pre-populate KV prefixes. Running: `./tools/warmup --service router --keys 100k` now.

Sylvia: SLO thresholds: if error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency increases by >45% from baseline, we halt and roll back. If partial degradation, hold at safe step and triage.

Maya: Rollback playbook: `lbctl set-weight router green 100 --reason "rollback"` then pin route to v2.14.3 and abort current deploy. Non-disruptive DB migrations? none.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed: healthchecks=OK, canary smoke=OK, capacity=green nodes available. Proceed when ready.

Jordan: Starting first weight change: 10% -> applying.

deploy-bot: Command executed: `lbctl set-weight router blue=10 green=90 --duration=5m`

oncall-bot: Alert rule: router_5xx_rate triggered? none.

Kevin: Warmup finished, cache hitrate bump to 82%.

Maya: We'll ramp to 30% at +5m unless any alerts. Reminder: observability links -- Grafana panels: /d/router/latency (watch p95), /d/router/errors (5xx)

Jordan: At +7m seeing 5xx spike on /api/chat: baseline 0.6% -> 1.9%. p95 +52%. Marking as investigating :eyes:

Kevin: Reproduced increased latency for large-payload requests. Tracing points to a regression in kv-cache miss path on v2.16.0. Not seeing DB errors.

Sylvia: Pause the ramp. Hold at 10%. Do not progress to 30%.

Maya: Agreed. Pausing. Everyone stand by for triage. If we don't find quick fix within 20m, we rollback to green=100 and pin v2.14.3.

Jordan: Adding synthetic traffic to blue canary to surface other failures: `tools/synth --target blue --qps 50 --endpoints /api/chat`.

deploy-bot: Canary telemetry: 5xx rate on blue at 2.1% over last 4m; error burst correlated with payload size >64KB.

Kevin: Quick mitigation candidate: revert a single optimization in v2.16.0 that changed streaming buffer handling. I can build v2.16.1-hotfix and deploy to blue in ~12m.

Sylvia: If hotfix build >12m, prefer rollback to green 100% now. We can't risk production degradation during the window.

Maya: Decision: Rollback to green 100% now and pin traffic to v2.14.3. We'll then deploy hotfix to a new blue canary outside the peak window.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: `lbctl set-weight router blue=0 green=100 --immediate --reason "observed 5xx spike on blue"`

oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-2027-1893, severity=low, summary="Partial rollout caused 5xx increase on blue; rolled back to green". Pager duty notified.

Jordan: Confirmed error rates back to baseline within 90s after rollback. p95 returned to normal.

Maya: I'll open a release note entry: "2027-04-12 02:08 UTC - Phased swap paused; blue v2.16.0 caused 5xx increase for large payloads. Traffic rolled back to green v2.14.3. Hotfix scheduled." Will post to release-notes channel.

Kevin: I'll start building v2.16.1-hotfix and include the streaming buffer revert. ETA 25m.

Sylvia: Postmortem checklist: collect traces, tag traces with deploy_id dep-2027-04-12-1798123456, capture canary traffic, and update LB gradual ramp policy to include a 2-step verification for payload-heavy endpoints.

Maya: Thanks all. After hotfix and validation we'll reopen a new thread for a fresh phased swap. :white_check_mark:
